purpose: Fictional AI-generated profile portraits for the seven existing local development accounts.

portraits.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: square profile avatar for a local speech-coaching demo app. Create one natural photographic head-and-shoulders portrait of a completely fictional person: a friendly adult man in his early thirties, short dark curly hair, medium brown skin, navy knit shirt. Centered face, looking toward the camera, shoulders visible, generous space around the entire hair and face so a circular avatar crop works. Soft daylight, subtle warm neutral blurred background, realistic skin texture, understated everyday clothing, welcoming expression. A single distinct person only. No text, logos, watermark, collage, comic style, or recognizable celebrity. Square composition.
